Cheery Tree Cat Rescue

An Independent Cat And Kitten Charity Based In The United Kingdom Which Specialise In Neonatal Specialist Care
We Are Two Women With Over 30 Years Of Experience In Feline Rescue And Rehabilitation, Specialising In Hand-Rearing And Taking On The Most Challenging Rescues. We Have A Small Army Of Cat Angels (Our Fosterers) Who Have Many Years Experience And Each Is An Expert In Their Own Ways. 

Here You Will Find Stories Past And Present On Our Rescues, Re Homes And Journeys. There Will Be Informative Videos Alongside Some Funny Kitten Ones! 

Please Like, Subscribe And Share Our Page
